summary: Legal authority to sunset E-Rate programs The FCC comment discusses various aspects of the E-Rate program, including its eligibility criteria, funding mechanisms, and implementation details. It highlights concerns about narrowing the eligibility scope, restricting special construction or dark fiber, changing the poverty and rural discount matrix, and tying E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes. The comment also mentions the need to address vendor influence, ensure parental autonomy, and protect privacy and free expression. Additional
